reuse.policy: Exact input, source, normalized pixels, rendered pixels, metric and pose hashes only.

scope: All 310 Legends printings, current original wording and identical artwork inputs. Compare release 0.3.4 painter to the calibrated Legends painter on the same frozen frame-normalized scans. Rank only the 303 accepted scan poses. Fixed application component regions and weights; this is structural compliance across measured components, not percent-identical image pixels. Credit diagnostics and color differences do not enter the ranked score. No parameters were selected from this full-set report.

limitations: Full-set evaluation includes fitting and validation printings; it is not a new independent validation cohort. Separate calibration fixtures retain reserved results.
Structural match uses fixed component regions and edge overlap; it is not pixel identity or a color score.
Seven rejected scan poses remain diagnostic only. Artist/legal metrics are diagnostic and excluded from the ranked aggregate.
Remaining typography outliers include Beasts of Bogardan, Sentinel, Fallen Angel and Dream Coat. Red scans often have heavy print grain; Torsten Von Ursus retains a frame-source mismatch.
